findings.title: CODEOWNERS is a personal account; required review is a single point
findings.impact: Required CODEOWNERS review resolves to one personal account (bus-factor/merge-authority ambiguity).
findings.recommendation: Replace with an organisation team handle once the repo moves under the org; document the fallback reviewer.

report: CI governance reviewed: ci-foundation runs pinned actions with contents:read, self-hosted routing for same-repo PRs and GitHub-hosted for forks, gitleaks repo scan, production audit, SBOM, coverage thresholds, multi-engine e2e, migration dry-run and SQL negatives. Branch-protection policy now requires foundation/migrations/e2e/license-and-vulnerability. Residual: CODEOWNERS resolves to a personal account.
